# F14: A goal’s page reads in one order on a computer and a phone, and what to act on is in the first screen

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/finish/10-goal-order.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured.

## What it checks

a goal's page reads in one order at every width (goal spec, 2.1; GT1). At 390 the sections come in the spec's order for each of eight demo goals; at 1440 the main column's and the side column's are each in that order. At 390 × 844 the status, the number, the primary action (when there is one) and the heading "Next steps and asks" are in the first screen; at 1440 × 900 so is the heading of Why. Nothing scrolls sideways.

- {at}: {k} is not in the first screen ({v} > {Math.round(f.fold)})
- {at}: main column in the order {f.main.join(' / ')}
- {at}: side column in the order {f.side.join(' / ')}
- {at}: the heading of Why is below the first screen
- {at}: the heading Next steps and asks is below the first screen
